groups.label: Summary
groups.description: Core storage operations and concurrency support declared by each service.

groups.label: Stat
groups.description: Metadata retrieval, conditional stat checks, and response header overrides.

groups.label: Read
groups.description: Object reads, suffix ranges, conditional reads, versioning, and header overrides.

groups.label: Write
groups.description: Single and multipart writes, append, metadata headers, conditional writes, and size limits.

groups.label: List
groups.description: Directory and prefix listing, pagination, native recursion, versions, deleted entries, and native glob.

groups.label: Delete
groups.description: Object deletion, native recursive deletion, conditional deletes, versioning, and batch size limits.

groups.label: Copy
groups.description: Server-side copy, segmented multipart copy, conditional copy, and metadata replacement.

groups.label: Compose
groups.description: Server-side object composition from existing source objects.

groups.label: Presign
groups.description: Presigned HTTP URL generation for client-side stat, read, write, and delete.

groups.label: Other
groups.description: Directory creation, rename, object restoration, and shared operator access.

fields.name: stat
fields.doc: Indicates if the operator supports metadata retrieval operations.

fields.name: stat_with_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional stat operations using If-Match are supported.

fields.name: stat_with_if_none_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional stat operations using If-None-Match are supported.

fields.name: stat_with_if_version_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional stat operations using version match are supported.

fields.name: stat_with_if_version_not_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional stat operations using version non-match are supported.

fields.name: stat_with_if_modified_since
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional stat operations using If-Modified-Since are supported.

fields.name: stat_with_if_unmodified_since
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional stat operations using If-Unmodified-Since are supported.

fields.name: stat_with_override_cache_control
fields.doc: Indicates if Cache-Control header override is supported during stat operations.

fields.name: stat_with_override_content_disposition
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Disposition header override is supported during stat operations.

fields.name: stat_with_override_content_type
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Type header override is supported during stat operations.

fields.name: stat_with_version
fields.doc: Indicates if versions stat operations are supported.

fields.name: read
fields.doc: Indicates if the operator supports read operations.

fields.name: read_with_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional read operations using If-Match are supported.

fields.name: read_with_if_none_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional read operations using If-None-Match are supported.

fields.name: read_with_if_version_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional read operations using version match are supported.

fields.name: read_with_if_version_not_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional read operations using version non-match are supported.

fields.name: read_with_if_modified_since
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional read operations using If-Modified-Since are supported.

fields.name: read_with_if_unmodified_since
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional read operations using If-Unmodified-Since are supported.

fields.name: read_with_override_cache_control
fields.doc: Indicates if Cache-Control header override is supported during read operations.

fields.name: read_with_override_content_disposition
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Disposition header override is supported during read operations.

fields.name: read_with_override_content_type
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Type header override is supported during read operations.

fields.name: read_with_version
fields.doc: Indicates if versions read operations are supported.

fields.name: read_with_suffix
fields.doc: Indicates if suffix read operations are supported.

fields.name: write
fields.doc: Indicates if the operator supports write operations.

fields.name: write_can_multi
fields.doc: Indicates if multiple write operations can be performed on the same object.

fields.name: write_can_empty
fields.doc: Indicates if writing empty content is supported.

fields.name: write_can_append
fields.doc: Indicates if append operations are supported.

fields.name: write_can_copy_from
fields.doc: Indicates if a non-append writer can natively copy source ranges into an in-progress write.

fields.name: write_with_content_type
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Type can be specified during write operations.

fields.name: write_with_content_disposition
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Disposition can be specified during write operations.

fields.name: write_with_content_encoding
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Encoding can be specified during write operations.

fields.name: write_with_content_language
fields.doc: Indicates if a write can store Content-Language and a subsequent stat can retrieve it.

fields.name: write_with_cache_control
fields.doc: Indicates if Cache-Control can be specified during write operations.

fields.name: write_with_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional write operations using If-Match are supported.

fields.name: write_with_if_none_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional write operations using If-None-Match are supported.

fields.name: write_with_if_version_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional write operations using version match are supported.

fields.name: write_with_if_version_not_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional write operations using version non-match are supported.

fields.name: write_with_if_not_exists
fields.doc: Indicates if write operations can be conditional on object non-existence.

fields.name: write_with_user_metadata
fields.doc: Indicates if custom user metadata can be attached during write operations.

fields.name: write_with_expires
fields.doc: Indicates if writes can set a lifetime for the new file.

fields.name: write_multi_max_size
fields.doc: Maximum size supported for multipart uploads. For example, AWS S3 supports up to 5GiB per part in multipart uploads.

fields.name: write_multi_min_size
fields.doc: Minimum size required for multipart uploads (except for the last part). For example, AWS S3 requires at least 5MiB per part.

fields.name: write_total_max_size
fields.doc: Maximum total size supported for write operations. For example, Cloudflare D1 has a 1MB total size limit.

fields.name: create_dir
fields.doc: Indicates if directory creation is supported.

fields.name: delete
fields.doc: Indicates if delete operations are supported.

fields.name: delete_with_version
fields.doc: Indicates if versions delete operations are supported.

fields.name: delete_with_recursive
fields.doc: Indicates if recursive delete operations are supported.

fields.name: delete_with_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional delete operations using If-Match are supported.

fields.name: delete_with_if_none_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional delete operations using If-None-Match are supported.

fields.name: delete_with_if_version_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional delete operations using version match are supported.

fields.name: delete_with_if_version_not_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional delete operations using version non-match are supported.

fields.name: delete_max_size
fields.doc: Maximum size supported for single delete operations.

fields.name: copy
fields.doc: Indicates if copy operations are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_if_not_exists
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional copy operations with if-not-exists are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional copy operations with if-match are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_if_none_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional copy operations with if-none-match are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_if_version_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional copy operations using version match are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_if_version_not_match
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional copy operations using version non-match are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_source_version
fields.doc: Indicates if copy operations from a specific source version are supported.

fields.name: copy_with_user_metadata
fields.doc: Indicates if copy operations can replace the destination's user metadata.

fields.name: copy_with_content_type
fields.doc: Indicates if copy operations can replace the destination's Content-Type.

fields.name: copy_with_content_language
fields.doc: Indicates if copy operations can replace the destination's Content-Language.

fields.name: copy_can_multi
fields.doc: Indicates if copy operations can be split into multiple server-side tasks.

fields.name: copy_multi_max_size
fields.doc: Maximum size supported for segmented copy tasks.

fields.name: copy_multi_min_size
fields.doc: Minimum size required for segmented copy tasks.

fields.name: compose
fields.doc: Indicates if the operator supports composing complete source objects.

fields.name: compose_with_content_type
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Type can be specified during composition.

fields.name: compose_with_content_disposition
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Disposition can be specified during composition.

fields.name: compose_with_content_encoding
fields.doc: Indicates if Content-Encoding can be specified during composition.

fields.name: compose_with_cache_control
fields.doc: Indicates if Cache-Control can be specified during composition.

fields.name: compose_with_user_metadata
fields.doc: Indicates if custom user metadata can be attached during composition.

fields.name: compose_with_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if composition supports a destination ETag match condition.

fields.name: compose_with_if_none_match
fields.doc: Indicates if composition supports a destination ETag non-match condition.

fields.name: compose_with_if_version_match
fields.doc: Indicates if composition supports a destination version match condition.

fields.name: compose_with_if_version_not_match
fields.doc: Indicates if composition supports a destination version non-match condition.

fields.name: compose_with_if_not_exists
fields.doc: Indicates if composition can require a missing destination.

fields.name: compose_with_source_version
fields.doc: Indicates if composition can select a specific source version.

fields.name: compose_with_source_if_match
fields.doc: Indicates if composition supports a source ETag match condition.

fields.name: restore
fields.doc: Indicates if restore operations are supported.

fields.name: restore_with_version
fields.doc: Indicates if restoring a specific version is supported.

fields.name: restore_with_if_not_exists
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional restore operations using if-not-exists are supported.

fields.name: rename
fields.doc: Indicates if rename operations are supported.

fields.name: rename_with_if_not_exists
fields.doc: Indicates if conditional rename operations with if-not-exists are supported.

fields.name: list
fields.doc: Indicates if list operations are supported.

fields.name: list_with_limit
fields.doc: Indicates if list operations support result limiting.

fields.name: list_with_start_after
fields.doc: Indicates if list operations support continuation from a specific point.

fields.name: list_with_recursive
fields.doc: Indicates if recursive listing is supported.

fields.name: list_with_versions
fields.doc: Indicates if listing with versions included is supported.

fields.name: list_with_deleted
fields.doc: Indicates if listing with deleted files included is supported.

fields.name: list_with_glob
fields.doc: Indicates if listing with a glob pattern is supported by this service stack.

fields.name: presign
fields.doc: Indicates if presigned URL generation is supported.

fields.name: presign_read
fields.doc: Indicates if presigned URLs for read operations are supported.

fields.name: presign_stat
fields.doc: Indicates if presigned URLs for stat operations are supported.

fields.name: presign_write
fields.doc: Indicates if presigned URLs for write operations are supported.

fields.name: presign_delete
fields.doc: Indicates if presigned URLs for delete operations are supported.

fields.name: shared
fields.doc: Indicate if the operator supports shared access.
